policies.cost_neighbors: Original complete physical hand order frozen at Battlecry acceptance; chosen original card gets -5, then original left/right distance d gets -(5-d), while positive. No collapsing slots or later acquired cards; native reference guards and cost layers.
policies.held_nature: Native held event progress once for own accepted physical Nature spell. Current copies preserve, base/acquired-mid-payload start fresh. A body without its original held-progress declaration errors rather than inferring unsupported history.
policies.drakrest: Original completed minion-versus-minion attack. Guard original attacker residence, then read current Attack and complete current enemy minion group at the explicit fresh execution window. Exclude only the original defender residence, so a genuinely reentered body is different. Native simultaneous MINION_ABILITY damage.
policies.recursive_shot: Native actual health result plus exact original damage/poison death cause, after death reactions via InvokeHealthResult. Recast a new physical spell through CastSpell only if actual legal random enemy target exists; every cast has independent native facts/payment/origin.
policies.multi_tribes: Pure metadata composition of ordinary PoolQuery: exclude only known printed sets with fewer than two distinct tribes and no all marker. Any-of tribe operand uses all currently declared metadata tokens plus all, requiring native known tribe metadata. ALL qualifies without deriving a finite universe from implemented cards. No executable-definition filtering; weights and unknown eligible content stay native.
policies.delivery_lookup: Post-producer callbacks retain active physical spell identity and join exactly one completed native discovery, pool, or ordered-group record by its actual SummonCause cast_id, source entity and causing player, then read complete entry_root_ids and every original delivered fact. No guessed allocator id, current hand/board scan, or later same-name body. Unexpected missing/ambiguous/orphan producer errors.
policies.umbras_tale: Native current-class plus neutral board Discover of collectible cost>=5 printed Deathrattle minion; after actual producer completion trigger original living delivered minions, including actual quantity extras. No extra hand acquisition.
policies.wormhole: Native Rewind plus one random collectible cost3 Beast board producer; after its actual completion each original surviving delivered minion attacks a native random current enemy character. No inferred just-generated board ids.
policies.shades: Native Rewind plus original ordered four-member group. After all original entries complete, two native random Bonus Effects per original recipient, in original delivery order; revalidate its exact MinionReference before every pick, so departure/reentry never borrows the second reward.
policies.unknowns: Complete native pool metadata/eligibility and executable checks remain; no removal by implementation coverage. Formal pool/M0 and CN/M6 remain separate.
policies.distance_damage: Original full physical target-controller board order and residences freeze at actual spell-body acceptance. Initial budget is base 5 plus the original native spell_bonus (same quote policy as ordinary declining waves); primary then each original left/right distance d receives quoted_budget-d when positive, with Damage spell_bonus_multiplier=0. Other health rules remain native per packet. Non-minion/inactive physical slots are not collapsed; stale residences skip without admitting replacements. Exact adjacency/range timing is explicit internal M6 policy.
policies.hysteria: Original enemy attacker group frozen once. At each original attacker window, validate its exact MinionReference, then sample one complete current other enemy minion residence relative to original causing player, and native ForceAttack with friendly_minions relation. Newly arrived minions may be current defenders but never new attackers; original departures skip without RNG.
